resumeText:
DANIEL HARTLEY
Adelaide, SA | 0400 000 000 | daniel.hartley@example.com
Australian Citizen – full working rights, no restrictions

SUMMARY
Junior QA professional with two years of freelance and informal software testing experience across web and mobile applications, including manual test case design, exploratory testing, and basic test automation using Python and Selenium. Comfortable working with developers in small Agile teams, logging and triaging bugs in Jira, and writing clear test documentation for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Seeking a Junior QA Engineer role based in Adelaide to build on self-directed testing experience within a structured, mentored team environment, and to keep developing automation skills alongside more experienced testers.

SKILLS
- Manual Testing & Exploratory Testing
- Test Case Design & Test Plans
- Bug Tracking (Jira, Trello)
- SQL (MySQL, basic querying for data validation)
- Python scripting for test automation
- Selenium WebDriver
- API Testing (Postman, REST)
- Agile/Scrum ceremonies
- Microsoft Excel (test matrices, reporting)
- Git / GitHub (version control for test scripts)

EXPERIENCE

Freelance Software Tester (Self-Employed) — Adelaide, SA
03/2022 – Present

Engaged directly by small local businesses and solo developers to test websites, booking systems and mobile apps before release, usually working remotely with occasional visits to client premises for in-person demos and handovers. Most engagements have run between four and twelve weeks, with ongoing ad-hoc retesting as clients push new features. Work has typically involved being the only dedicated tester on the project, so a large part of the role has been setting up testing processes from scratch for clients who had previously released software without any structured testing at all.

- Designed and executed manual test cases for a local tradie booking platform, covering functional, UI and cross-browser testing across Chrome, Firefox and Safari, and presenting findings to the client in plain language rather than technical jargon.
- Wrote and maintained a Python/Selenium regression suite for a client's e-commerce checkout flow, which reduced the amount of manual re-testing needed after each release and gave the client more confidence pushing changes during busy periods.
- Logged and triaged defects in Jira for three separate client projects, working with each client's sole developer to reproduce issues, agree on severity, and track fixes through to verification.
- Used Postman to test REST API endpoints for a rostering app, checking authentication flows, error handling and a range of edge cases before handover to the client's development team.
- Built SQL queries against test databases to validate that booking records matched what was displayed in the client-facing app, catching several data mismatches before launch.
- Put together test plans and simple reporting in Excel so non-technical clients could understand test coverage and outstanding issues without needing to read raw bug tickets.
- Managed test scripts and supporting documentation in Git repositories shared with client developers, keeping a clear history of changes to the automated checks over time.

Retail Assistant — Harvest Grocer, Adelaide, SA
01/2019 – 02/2022 (part-time while studying; moved into freelance testing full-time from 03/2022)

Worked part-time on the shop floor and at the register while completing a Diploma of Information Technology. Responsibilities included serving customers, restocking shelves, handling cash and card transactions, and occasionally training new casual staff on store procedures during busy trading periods such as Christmas and end-of-financial-year sales. Developed close attention to detail and comfort working through repetitive checks under time pressure, skills carried directly into later test execution work, and gained early experience explaining issues clearly to customers, which later helped when writing bug reports for non-technical stakeholders in freelance testing engagements.

PROJECTS

Personal Testing Portfolio (ongoing) — Adelaide, SA
Built a self-directed testing portfolio by selecting three existing demo and open-source web applications and writing full test plans, exploratory test charters and bug reports for each, purely to practise structured test documentation outside of paid client work. These were chosen specifically because they were complex enough to require real planning, rather than simple todo-list style apps.

- Recipe Sharing App: wrote over 40 manual test cases covering registration, recipe upload and search filters, uncovering several usability issues around image upload size limits and inconsistent error messages.
- Budget Tracker Web App: used Selenium WebDriver and Python to automate 15 regression checks around transaction entry and category totals, running them locally before and after simulated code changes.
- Task Management Tool: performed exploratory testing focused on drag-and-drop reordering and concurrent editing between two browser sessions, documenting edge cases and reproduction steps in a shared spreadsheet for review.

EDUCATION

Diploma of Information Technology — TAFE SA, Adelaide
02/2017 – 12/2018

Completed core units in software testing fundamentals, database design, networking basics, and web development. Relevant units included:
- Software Testing Fundamentals
- Database Design and SQL
- Introduction to Programming (Python)
- Web Development Fundamentals
- Networking Basics
- Business Communication
- Project Management Fundamentals
- IT Security Fundamentals
- Systems Analysis and Design
- Workplace Health and Safety in IT Environments

Completed a capstone assignment designing a full test plan for a mock inventory management system, including risk assessment and a traceability matrix mapping requirements to test cases. Also completed a group assignment building a simple ticket-booking website using HTML, CSS and PHP, where responsibilities included writing the booking confirmation page and testing form validation across the group's other pages before submission.

Senior Secondary Certificate (SACE) — Northfield High School, Adelaide
2012 – 2016
Completed Stage 2 subjects including Mathematics, English, Information Processing and Technology, and Physics. Participated in the school's IT club, helping younger students troubleshoot basic computer issues during lunchtime drop-in sessions.

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT / COURSES
- Software Testing Foundations (online, self-paced) — 2021
- Python for Automation Testing (online course) — 2021
- SQL for Data Analysis (online course) — 2020
- Introduction to Agile and Scrum (online course) — 2022
- Postman API Testing Masterclass (online course) — 2022
- Git and GitHub Essentials (online course) — 2021
- Exploratory Testing Techniques (online webinar series) — 2023
- Bug Reporting That Developers Actually Read (online workshop) — 2023

VOLUNTEER EXPERIENCE
Adelaide Community Tech Meetup — Volunteer Helper
06/2022 – Present
Helps set up monthly meetups for local developers and testers, including room setup, registration desk duties, and occasional note-taking during talks. Has also helped a couple of speakers dry-run their demos the week before, pointing out confusing steps from a newcomer's perspective.

HOBBIES AND INTERESTS
Enjoys board games, hiking in the Adelaide Hills, building small hobby electronics projects with a Raspberry Pi, and reading science fiction novels. Also keeps a small personal blog documenting testing exercises and lessons learned from freelance projects.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Comfortable working across Windows, macOS and Linux environments for testing purposes. Has set up virtual machines to test web applications across multiple operating systems and browser versions. Available for full-time work in Adelaide, with flexibility to work on-site, hybrid, or fully remote depending on the role.

REFERENCES
Sarah Nguyen, Owner, Nguyen's Trades Booking Co — contact details available on request
Mark Fenton, Freelance Developer — contact details available on request
References from TAFE SA lecturers also available on request
